coverage.headline: U.S. Trustee Objects to Plan Confirmation Over Opt-Out Third-Party Releases and Proposed Charitable Donation of Residual Trust Funds
coverage.summary: The U.S. Trustee filed an objection asking the court to deny confirmation of Harvest Sherwood's Third Amended Plan, targeting opt-out third-party release provisions and a proposed charitable donation of residual trust funds, ahead of the August 5 confirmation hearing.

coverage.headline: Harvest Sherwood Gets OK On $150M Replacement DIP
coverage.summary: A Texas bankruptcy judge approved Harvest Sherwood's $150 million replacement DIP financing facility and set up bidding procedures for its exit funding, defeating an objection from a litigation finance firm.

coverage.headline: Creditor Vote Set For Harvest Sherwood Liquidation Plan
coverage.summary: Harvest Sherwood received court clearance for an August confirmation hearing for its Chapter 11 liquidation plan after the Texas bankruptcy judge found the plan disclosure statement, with some tweaks, contained sufficient information for creditors.
